name: Fresh mode never resumes, even with a current draft and a current unlinked manuscript
The 14 November case: a draft repaired into a report is superseded
A draft written after the latest report is still resumed
A late-recovered link dates from its validated manuscript and does not supersede a later draft
A manuscript composed into a report by a later attempt is superseded by that report
Only the same Fact Pack qualifies (unchanged rule)
History with a missing or unreadable time is malformed, never treated as empty
The review store returns Postgres time strings; they parse
